name: Kakuka Houkou
source:
A bespectacled female strategist. She easily gets nosebleeds when having explicit fantasies, and as a result is sometimes found passed out on the ground and often mistaken to be dead (due to a pool of blood from her nosebleeding).

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Koihime_Mus%C5%8D_characters#Kakuka]Wikipedia[/url]]
